protocol.policy: one direct low-score/high-score NMS swap per frame
protocol.primary_ap: original fused scores, frame order, same output budget

training_settings.checkpoint_selection: fixed last epoch; no validation selection

investment_gate.rule: At threshold 0.90: distortion must gain >=0.005 frame-order AP70 over original and best equal-capacity control in at least two adverse weathers; net GT gain and each leave-one-scene-out advantage must be positive there; Clean loss vs both references <=0.001. Exploratory screen only.
investment_gate.evidence_status: reused exploratory validation; fresh scenes needed
